title: Doctor Appointment in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **The four-week promise is real but narrow.** The KV Berlin appointment service on **116117** places you with a specialist within **four weeks at most**, and it says in the same breath that minor complaints and routine check-ups are outside that promise.

**For most specialists the clock only starts with a twelve-digit code.** A plain referral opens nothing at the service. Ask your GP for an **Überweisung mit Vermittlungscode**. No referral at all is needed for a GP, an eye doctor, a gynaecologist, a children's doctor or a first psychotherapy consultation.

**The fast route cannot give you English.** The service states plainly that treatment in a foreign language cannot be taken into account when it places you. The separate public practice search at arztsuche.116117.de does have a **Fremdsprachen** filter, so booking yourself is the only route that protects language.

**Five open hours a week, no appointment.** Full specialist practices in skin, eyes, ENT, orthopaedics, urology, gynaecology, surgery, neurology and psychiatry owe **five hours of offene Sprechstunde** every week. Practices choose their own times, so ring and ask.
**A referral is valid in its own quarter and the next one.** One written in September runs to **31 December 2026**. One written on 2 October runs to the end of March.
**Teeth are outside all of it.** The appointment service places **no dental or orthodontic appointments**, whatever paper you hold. Berlin runs a separate dental on-call service.
